claim_ceiling: Static source/hash review only. Phase-count labels are driver/Root expectations, not a fresh 28597/720/77ELF/1010/1011 guard PASS. One future same-process timing cannot establish variance, margin readiness or speedup.
positive_static_checks: Exact driver/proposal/selector pins match independently supplied identities.
Loaded modules compile the exact selected raw bytes with the actual selected path as filename and fresh namespaces; no co_filename alias or callback/clock reassignment is present.
SelectedOntologyExecutor constructor parses the closed existing installation selection and does not call provision, run_native or a native store.

Measurement callbacks are original API Source verify; dependencies.preflight; dependencies.verify_installed; control.installed; and executor.guard. Original Source entry/exit are intended; no full guard ran in this review.
Full preflight and executor source_guard use existing ELF inspection via readelf; these are inspection subprocesses, not Lab seal/append/read operations.
Phase timing uses actual time.perf_counter and process_time. Elapsed values are taken before phase persistence. Process CPU excludes child readelf CPU.
Output leaves use exclusive creation, nofollow leaf and file fsync at mode0600; existing leaves are never overwritten. Failures remain diagnostic rather than qualification.
All remaining loaded input module and selector pins are recaptured in finally; FD delta measures post-constructor phase region.
required_successor_review: Review exact frozen corrected driver before Root execution after the live runtime releases its exclusive slot.

static_findings.correction: Use a self-contained independently selected held nofollow capture before parsing proposal and before executing each module, preserving exact supplied pins, true filename/co_filename and all later existing captures. Preserve driver1.
static_findings.finding: The selected module hash is checked, but execution precedes descriptor-anchored nofollow/regular-file/stamp/ancestor-attachment capture. Later control.capture cannot retroactively establish the true physical origin of code already executed. Proposal itself is also initially read by Path.read_bytes.

static_findings.correction: Mark entry success inside the entry callback before any phase persistence; preflight exclusive fresh output leaves and owned custody before guards. Preserve partial evidence and report persistence/exit failures without automatic retry.
static_findings.finding: entered=True is assigned only after measured(entry) returns. measured persists a phase from its finally block; if entry verification succeeds but phase emission fails, entered stays false and finally skips the paired Source exit verification.

static_findings.correction: Make the successor explicit/self-contained with the exact selected dependency path, or independently bind and document the required prefix; Root chose self-contained driver2.
static_findings.finding: The script requires isolated/no-site Python but does not itself add selected BASE/deps. Bare selected -I/-S execution therefore lacks jsonschema/cryptography distribution metadata used by API guard.verify.
static_findings.scope: Root directly states its planned Family4Prefix already inserts exact selected BASE/deps before runpy; this is not a demonstrated blocker for that planned launcher. The supplied driver has no explicit standalone dependency-path contract.
